howto: Press Play. The landscape lives through its own days and nights: nothing to win or lose.
Drag the view or hold the arrows to walk. Tap the scene, or the freeze button, to freeze time.
Keep a tree, flower, creature or sky sight in view for a moment and it goes in the field log.
Fill all fourteen entries. END shows your field notes; New day starts again at dawn.
tips: Fireflies, the moon and the starfield only appear at night: press + to speed the day along.
Sunrise is short, between about 05:00 and 06:00. Scrub back with [ if you miss it.
God-rays need a high sun, around midday.
Blooms are in the foreground meadow: walk slowly and each colour turns up.
New world (or R) grows a different valley from a new seed; your field log is kept.

controls.keyboard: A / D or left and right arrows walk, W walks fast, Space freezes time, , and . change day speed, [ and ] scrub the day, L shows the field log, R grows a new world. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Drag to walk, tap to freeze time. The bottom bar has walk (hold), freeze, slower, faster, LOG and END.

difficulty: No difficulty setting: nothing can be lost or failed. The day speed (0.25x to 4x) is the only pacing knob; night sightings come round sooner at higher speeds.

cheats.effect: Two new day speeds, 8x and 16x, and the day jumps to 8x
Twice as many fireflies at night
The bird flock doubles in size
Every species is ticked in the field log

features.autosave: The field log saves the moment something is logged; the seed, day, clock, camera and day speed save every 5 seconds and resume next visit
features.goals-or-quests: The field log: fourteen trees, blooms, creatures and sky sights to find, with a hint for the next one
features.day-time-ui: The HUD shows DAY N, a 24-hour clock and the phase (NIGHT, DAWN, DAY, DUSK); the sky, sun and moon follow it
features.inventory: The field log panel (LOG button or L) lists every species found, with the ones still to find
features.results: END shows your field notes: days lived, new species this session and the log total, then New day or Keep watching
features.tutorial: Three coach marks on the first Play: walking, the time controls and the field log; replay from How to play
